description: Descartes Datamyne is a commercial database of import and export records, including US import and export data, bills of lading and trade statistics for countries in North and Latin America, Asia-Pacific, Europe, the Middle East and Africa, with a chemical industry offering that gives a near real-time view of chemical trade flows, shipment volumes and values. Users research products, monitor competitors, find suppliers, gauge demand in markets and map traffic patterns, shipment volumes and distribution hubs for more resilient supply chains. It is produced by the Descartes Systems Group. Coverage is global, by the countries listed on the site. Access is by paid subscription through a web application with Excel downloads and a global trade data API, with a free trial and demonstrations on request; no prices were read. Caveats: coverage of shipment-level records varies by country's disclosure rules, and the page read is marketing material without data documentation. For simulation it provides shipment-level trade links between chemical suppliers and buyers for building supply networks and testing how port closures or plant outages reroute or cut chemical flows. It is related to the Panjiva supply chain intelligence record in this catalogue, a comparable commercial shipment database.
